BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff (
    handoff_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL,
    request_hash char(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    state_ref_kind varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (state_ref_kind IN ('accepted_draft', 'finalized_profile')),
    state_ref_version bigint NOT NULL CHECK (state_ref_version >= 1),
    dialog_id uuid NOT NULL,
    teacher_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
    goal_code varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (goal_code ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$'),
    goal_version varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (goal_version ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$'),
    graph_version varchar(128) NOT NULL CHECK (length(graph_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    status varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACCEPTED' CHECK (status = 'ACCEPTED'),
    execution_status varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_STARTED' CHECK (execution_status = 'NOT_STARTED'),
    content_status varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NOT_CREATED' CHECK (content_status = 'NOT_CREATED'),
    readiness_observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    CHECK (created_at >= readiness_observed_at),
    UNIQUE (student_id, idempotency_key),
    UNIQUE (student_id, state_ref_kind, state_ref_version)
);

COMMENT ON TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff IS
    'Immutable S8 receipt only; no profile, raw dialog text, Course, path, content, or execution state.';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff()
RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding plan handoffs are immutable';
    RETURN OLD;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff
BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate()
RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding plan handoffs are immutable';
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate
BEFORE TRUNCATE ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff
FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate();

COMMIT;
